route: Starting at simulation second 30: walk forward at yaw 350 for 18 seconds, stop and turn 180 degrees smoothly over 3 seconds, walk back for 18 seconds at yaw 530, then stop and turn another 180 degrees over 3 seconds. Repeat this 42-second cycle. No teleportation, movement during turns, navigation, scene changes or camera-history effects. Set heading through the verified CharacterController API and use engine forward actions.
recording: Record from approximately simulation second 28 for duration plus 4 seconds, at native 2560x1440 via WGC and AMF, retaining variable-rate timestamps. All three full passes recorded identically; performance includes encoding overhead and is compared with the earlier separately measured unrecorded runs only with that distinction explicit.
pilot: One standard/off 84-second measurement spanning two full cycles, with native recording and CPU PresentMon. Review outbound/return cover and images before three full passes. Permit at most one route correction, retaining the failure and amendment before more gameplay.

acceptance.sampling: Interpolate logged camera positions and directions at each integer simulation second. Moving time counts one-second horizontal displacement >=1m. Slow-interior checks exclude two seconds after walk starts and one second before each stop. Cross-pass position/direction check samples 31..209 inclusive; no alignment or retiming.

performance: Retain every PresentMon CPU trace row and companion frame/event record. Report actual application Present cadence, p50/p95/p99/max intervals and intervals over 33.333/50ms. Exclude WGC internal records explicitly. Report GPU copy/inference/draw and capture-to-Present age separately, preserving negative clock-skew samples. No unchanged ETW/DXGI display probe; moving capture-to-display and physical input-to-photon remain unknown.
review: Review chronological contact sheets covering all three full videos, native-size keys at relative capture times 3,20,41,62,83,125,167,181 seconds, and original-speed playback where the review tools permit it. State the actual review scope, retain all stalls and fallback events, and do not turn automated engine motion into a physical-input claim.
working_package: No model, shader, controls or distributed package change. The new route is isolated benchmark code. This test addresses sustained movement, cadence and visibility coverage, not the unfinished substantial photorealistic appearance objective.
